tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Shanghai Masters Day 5: Novak Djokovic faces 2023 champ Hubert Hurkacz after 19 aces from the Pole, while Alexander Zverev opens against Wu Yibing and Ben Shelton meets Daniel Altmaier on Stadium Court • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Squash Open rests Oct. 9 after qualifying finals at OWest—Seif Refaay and Habiba Hani among last entrants before main-draw Round One begins Friday ahead of the Pyramids stage • [BADMINTON] Arctic Open quarterfinals in Vantaa: PV Sindhu beat Riko Gunji 21-9, 21-12 and meets Ratchanok Intanon Friday as the Super 500 field narrows toward weekend semis • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Chicago Cup pro quarterfinals Friday at Life Time Northbrook—1,500-point Cup with PickleballTV and FS2 from 2 p.m. CT as Anna Leigh Waters chases career title No. 200 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash quarterfinal day in Beijing: Zhou Qihao swept Tomokazu Harimoto, qualifier Zhu Sibing upset Kuai Man, and men's singles QFs plus doubles semis decide the season's final Grand Smash bracket

newsItems.title: Sindhu Reaches Arctic QFs
newsItems.excerpt: PV Sindhu rolled past Riko Gunji 21-9, 21-12 at the BWF Super 500 in Vantaa and faces Ratchanok Intanon on Oct. 9 for a semifinal berth.

newsItems.title: Chicago Cup Hits Quarterfinals
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Chicago Cup's pro draws move into quarterfinals Friday indoors at Life Time Northbrook, with 1,500 ranking points per division and coverage on PickleballTV and FS2.

newsItems.title: Djokovic Meets Hurkacz In Shanghai
newsItems.excerpt: Round-of-64 action at the Rolex Shanghai Masters features Novak Djokovic against Hubert Hurkacz, fresh off Beijing title No. 102, plus Zverev–Wu Yibing and Shelton–Altmaier.

newsItems.title: Egyptian Open Qualifying Wraps
newsItems.excerpt: Qualifying at OWest finished Oct. 8 with Seif Refaay and Habiba Hani among the last main-draw qualifiers before the PSA Diamond event shifts toward Pyramids play.
